rationale: The bug is in observerEci, which places the observer on a hard-coded sphere (RE = 6378.137 km) and feeds WGS84 geodetic lat/lon straight into geocentric ECI math, mislocating the observer by up to ~21 km at the poles and tilting close-satellite look angles. horizontal.ts only rotates coordinate frames (ecliptic → equatorial → horizontal) and is mathematically correct; the cheaper agent mistook the downstream horizontal-transform file for the owner because it handles alt-az, but the actual geodetic-model error lives in the upstream observer ECI builder.
